node.content: {"sections": [{"spans": [{"text": "For context SF downtown cell phone usage data implies a greater decline than any other major US city (", "modifiers": {}}, {"text": "source", "modifiers": {"link": {"type": "url", "url": "https://apolloacademy.com/downtown-has-not-yet-fully-recovered/"}}}, {"text": "):", "modifiers": {}}], "indent": 0, "quoted": false, "type": "plain", "is_rtl": false}, {"spans": [{"text": "", "modifiers": {"image": "https://qph.cf2.quoracdn.net/main-qimg-94635bde29038d37f855092629e49166", "height": 576, "width": 1024, "master_url": "https://qph.cf2.quoracdn.net/main-qimg-406eb8e956e11c55757ffcf10140b4da", "is_deleted": false, "is_sensitive": false, "is_uploaded_by_bot": false, "zoomable": true, "dominant_color": "#fdfdfd", "has_transparency": false}}], "indent": 0, "quoted": false, "type": "image", "is_rtl": false}, {"spans": [{"text": "Some parts of it aren\u2019t surprising:", "modifiers": {}}], "indent": 0, "quoted": false, "type": "plain", "is_rtl": false}, {"spans": [{"text": "Tech companies were best suited to remote work and so a much higher percentage of the working population in SF is able to work from home.", "modifiers": {}}], "indent": 0, "quoted": false, "type": "unordered-list", "is_rtl": false}, {"spans": [{"text": "Real estate prices in SF pre-pandemic were higher than most other cities as a result of the tech boom and local politics that resist new construction.", "modifiers": {}}], "indent": 0, "quoted": false, "type": "unordered-list", "is_rtl": false}, {"spans": [{"text": "But I think the surge in crime and the dysfunction of the government in dealing with it has been a surprise to most people, and that is certainly contributing to the exodus.", "modifiers": {}}], "indent": 0, "quoted": false, "type": "plain", "is_rtl": false}]}

node.content: {"sections": [{"spans": [{"text": "As far as I know, the only good options for this are hardware-software combinations. Apple\u2019s Center Stage feature, available on newer iPad models, can do it. Facebook Portal and newer Amazon Echo Show models have it as well. There is a newer desktop-oriented webcam in beta called Opal Camera that has this as well.", "modifiers": {}}], "indent": 0, "quoted": false, "type": "plain", "is_rtl": false}, {"spans": [{"text": "I suspect the reason there isn\u2019t a standard software-only solution is that video quality degrades without optical zoom. But I think zooming up to 2x in software could still make this very useful and haven\u2019t found a solution. Given the rise of remote work there should be a very large market for this. Maybe it will show up in a future version of Zoom.", "modifiers": {}}], "indent": 0, "quoted": false, "type": "plain", "is_rtl": false}]}
